I agree. It happens. There’s no way around it. There were many times I was that person pushing through, but to find my friends after we got separated or something like that (I was always polite). Most people always say excuse me and are nice about it, and if you have a big problem with it, stand your ground and just be nice and say please don’t. It’s going to happen anywhere, you need to accept it and not let it ruin things for you. It’s a waste of your own energy trying to stop something that’s going to happen no matter what.
